newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Liz Claiborne started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Liz Claiborne started.

text.p: -- Robertson, Stephens & Co said analyst Alexandra DalPan initiated coverage of Liz Claiborne Inc with a long-term attractive rating.

-- said Liz Claiborne is emerging from a major turnaround with "revitalized" product offerings, more aggressive merchandising and marketing strategies, a streamlined operating structure and a more efficient use of capital.

-- said product line extensions and growth initiatives could serve as catalysts for acceleration in top line growth to at least 10 percent beginning in fiscal 1998, up from the 0.2 percent seen in the past three years.
-- said new growth initiatives and accelerating trends in core lines could lead to earnings growth at the upper end of the 15-20 percent range in fiscal 1997 and fiscal 1998.
-- set earnings estimates of $2.48 for fiscal 1997 and $2.88 in fiscal 1998.
